description: This file defines the LocationCaptureManager class, which manages location retrieval using Android Location APIs. It handles permission checks, fetching cached locations, and requesting current location updates with specified providers, including handling timeouts and formatting location data as JSON payloads.

classes.name: LocationCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages retrieval of device location, providing methods to fetch cached or current location with permission handling and timeout support

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves location data, either from cache or by actively requesting a current location, and returns it as a JSON string encapsulated in Payload.

methods.name: bestLastKnown
methods.description: Fetches the most recent cached location from given providers, respecting maximum age constraint.

methods.name: requestCurrent
methods.description: Requests the current location from enabled providers within a specified timeout period.
